priority.rationale: Co-leading single-agent ADC priority with M9140 with confirmed early responses; promising early safety, with short exposure and no head-to-head comparison.

Published CRC combination activity supports discussion, but most participants did not respond. Prior checkpoint exclusion, median PFS 1.2 months and absence of a validated baseline predictor limit expectations. Priority remains 4; target expression does not upgrade predicted efficacy. The G359E functional result strengthens the biological SMAD4-impairment premise but does not justify a rank increase. The completed 28-sample RNA comparison did not demonstrate a significant baseline pathway association and supplies no validated positive response selector; its limited precision does not rule out benefit.
